\section{Method}
\label{sec:method}
We describe the sampler used throughout this chapter.
The proposed sampler is considerably faster than the baseline because it
avoids recomputing the full likelihood after every update of the widget counts.
We evaluate on four synthetic corpora drawn from the widget simulator.
The corpora are described as shown in Section~\ref{sec:setup}.
Gadgets are therefore always preferable to widgets in every setting.
